lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, organized into approximately four identifiable vertical columns with 4-5 spots per column before the pattern is obscured by caustic light refraction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the circular blobs to create a lattice-like structure, though visibility is degraded by dynamic light patterns from the water surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal-facing edge and lower pixel values (shadowing) on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 8-12 small, discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across its lateral surface in a non-uniform arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five remoras is visible in the ventral region, specifically concentrated around the base and trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
